related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment environmental-capability projection and append-only observation correction mechanism

request.operation: correct the exact pressure occurrence role after the bounded projection dropped all supporting-context rows

outcome.reason: The target records the directly observed initial output-truncation failure and its exact invocation/completion events. It is the occurrence establishing the pressure; the separate verification and ECI readback records remain supporting context.
outcome.interpretation_limit: This corrects classification for ECI retention and does not strengthen the underlying event evidence or establish recurrence.

record_correction.reason: The pressure record describes the direct truncation occurrence itself, not secondary context. Correcting this exact role allows the established compact ECI path-retention policy to retain the occurrence with its linked pressure and improvement relation.

not_measured: Whether a separate agent would classify the same evidence identically without this correction.
Whether preserving one linked path changes subsequent agent behavior or reduces intervention burden.
Whether this pressure recurs across additional capabilities or sessions.
